articles.summary: CareTrust REIT, Inc. (NYSE:CTRE) (“CareTrust” or the “Company”) announced today that it has entered into a definitive agreement with LNT Care Developments Holdings Limited (“LNT”), a prolific United Kingdom-based care home developer and operator, to acquire 45 new care homes for approximately £1.1 billion in a strategic transaction for the Company that secures a pathway to building a significant senior housing operating portfolio (“SHOP”) platform across the U.K. The transaction is structured with staggered closings, the first of which occurred on October 1, 2026, and comprised 24 homes, all constructed within the past two years, for approximately £576 million (or approximately $764 million) 1 exclusive of transaction costs. 2 The investment was funded using a combination of proceeds from the settlement of outstanding forward equity agreements and a draw on the Company’s revolving credit facility. articles.title: CareTrust Announces Strategic SHOP Pipeline Agreement with LNT Care Developments to Acquire 45 New UK Care Homes for £1.1 Billion

articles.summary: CareTrust REIT, Inc. (NYSE:) announced today that it plans to release its third quarter 2026 financial results after the U.S. markets close on Thursday, November 5, 2026. Representatives of CareTrust REIT’s management team will host a conference call to discuss the results and other current matters the following day. Conference Call CareTrust REIT invites current and prospective investors to listen to the call on Friday, November 6, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time (8:00 a.m. Pacific Time). The toll-free dial-in number is 1 (833) 461-5787 or toll dial-in number is 1 (585) 542-9983 and the conference ID number is 313959106. To listen to the call online as a webcast, or to view any financial or other statistical information required by SEC Regulation G, please visit the Investors section of the CareTrust REIT website at http://investor.caretrustreit.com . articles.summary: CareTrust REIT, Inc. (NYSE: CTRE) announced today the release of its sixth annual Corporate Sustainability Report, highlighting the continued evolution of its sustainability and corporate responsibility initiatives during a year of significant business and portfolio growth. The report outlines CareTrust’s consistent, operator-first approach to sustainability and the measured expansion of its strategy across three distinct platforms: its core skilled nursing business, UK care home portfolio, and emerging seniors housing operating portfolio (SHOP).
